purpose: Paper-grade factorial ablation for the current best shared-MASA GeoExplorer variant at 0.6240 SR. This is not only leave-one-out: it enumerates every combination of the four controlled mechanisms so that main effects and interactions can both be inspected.

paper_protocol_anchor.source: GeoExplorer paper snippets and local shared-MASA protocol
paper_protocol_anchor.core_setting: 5x5 grid, B=10, C={4,5,6,7,8}, greedy success ratio by distance
paper_protocol_anchor.original_method: GeoExplorer combines goal-oriented distance reward with curiosity-driven intrinsic reward based on action-state dynamics prediction error.
paper_protocol_anchor.baseline_reference: GOMAA-Geo uses action modeling plus distance-based extrinsic rewards; GeoExplorer adds goal-agnostic curiosity reward.

fixed_controls: Training data grid: canonical MASA+MM-GAG train grid used by the current 0.624 line.
RL budget: 480000 timesteps for every trained branch.
Hardware policy: use GPU0 and GPU1 only.
PPO controls: target_kl=0.02, eps_clip=0.20, lr_actor=1e-4, lr_critic=1e-4.
Evaluation: strict shared MASA task bundle, 250 total tasks, C={4,5,6,7,8}, B=10, greedy policy.
No top-k promotion or selection before shared evaluation; every branch is evaluated.
The g0_p0_e0_v0 branch is a same-data no-added-mechanism control inside this codebase, not a separate official-paper GeoExplorer reimplementation.

reward_formula_under_test.implementation: reward_total = reward_ex + factor * reward_in * gate_weight(dist) + pbrs_bonus(prev_dist, dist) + finish_bonus(dist)
notes: finish_bonus is fixed off in all factorial branches.
factor remains 1.0 in all factorial branches.
G and P affect the reward function directly; E affects PPO regularization; V affects checkpoint selection during training.

interpretation_plan: Primary table: all 16 combinations sorted by shared MASA SR.
Core reward-factor subtable: compare G/P 2x2 cells under E=1,V=1 to isolate reward-mechanism contributions near the anchor.
Main effects: compute mean SR when each factor is on minus mean SR when it is off.
Two-way interactions: inspect whether G and P are complementary, redundant, or harmful together.
Distance-bucket interpretation: report not just overall SR but d4-d8, because the anchor's known strength is d7/d8.
